draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.22, the 86th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 9th of 26 at LB. He lasted until pick 115, well after his grade rank (86th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 112 tackles in 2024, 4th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Arizona Cardinals. 16 career games and 9 starts over 1 completed season, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 3 AV in 2025. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 14.6% (9th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 off-ball linebacker who played: 76 combined tackles against a median of 23, above the norm.
